verdict.rationale: Locking an authenticator or password app behind biometrics or a PIN is a fair axis for this kind of product, but no evidence item documents a Bitwarden biometric or PIN unlock. The only related mention is a community wish for fingerprint auth on Linux, which merely implies the feature exists on other platforms and is not affirmative evidence of an app-lock capability.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes
